verdict.rationale: Cekura lets users run synthetic conversations, mock tools, and test agents without hitting real production traffic or external API keys (cekura-docs-16, cekura-docs-19, cekura-docs-23), which functions as a sandbox-style testing environment for voice agents. However, there is no explicit documentation framing this as a 'sandbox vs production data' isolation guarantee, no mention of data separation/environments, and no independent verification of this isolation. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/production data isolation guarantees, documentation on environment separation, and independent confirmation that test runs never touch production data stores.
